mostWorthwhile.text: The closing image of seeing an empty box differently was the most worthwhile passage: it connected the inventions to curiosity beyond the story.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter had no construction decision, so there was little to do beyond reading the ending.

surprise.text: I was struck by the explicit distinction between the invented lift tile and the real mechanisms.

arbitrary.text: No action in this chapter felt arbitrary; there were no gameplay actions to assess.

continue.text: I would be curious to try another chapter with a hands-on mechanism, but this ending alone did not offer enough gameplay to judge how engaging the choices would be.
